details.title: Kissht: Instant Personal Loans
details.description:
Kissht is a trusted digital loan app by 60+ million Indians for Instant personal loans and flexible business loans tailored to their personal and business financial needs. Whether you are salaried or self-employed, Kissht offers both personal loans and business loans to provide immediate financial assistance

Kissht Personal Loan Offerings
● Loan Amount - ₹10,000 to ₹5,00,000
● Interest rates - Starting from 1% per month
● Tenure - 6 to 60 months
● APR Range (Min-Max): 17%–45%*

Why Choose Kissht Digital Lending App

1. Kissht Offers Personal loans for Salaried & Self-Employed Individuals. The loan ranges from ₹5,000 to ₹5,00,000, with 100% digital processing, minimal documentation, Flexible EMI repayment options, and the lowest interest rate among other NBFCs, and instant loan approval in 5 mins with same-day loan disbursal.

✔️ Personal Loan for all use cases:

👉 Personal Loan for Students/ Education Fund
👉 Personal Loan for Medical Emergency or Medical bills
👉 Personal Loan for Debt Consolidation
👉 Personal Loan for Wedding Expenses
👉 Personal Loan for Home Repairs
👉 Personal Loan for Travel

2. Kissht provides tailored business loan designed for entrepreneurs. It offers business loans from ₹5,000 to ₹5,00,000 with 100% Digital KYC, Zero Paperwork, Affordable interest rate with Flexible Tenure Ranges, and Flexible EMI repayment plan

✔️ Business Loan for all use cases:

👉 Business Loan for MSME Owners
👉 Business Loan for Startup Companies
👉 Business Loan for Small Business Owner
👉 Business Loan for E-Commerce startups
👉 Business Loan for Manufacturers

Example of Unsecured Personal Loan
Loan amount (Sanctioned): ₹ 1,25,000.
Tenure: 24 months.
Interest Rate: 33% per annum.
Processing Fee (incl. GST): ₹ 8,850.
Total Interest: ₹ 47,467.
EMI: ₹ 7,184.
APR: 41 %.
Sanctioned Loan amount is ₹ 1,25,000.
Net Disbursed amount is ₹ 1,16,150.
Total loan repayment amount is ₹ 1,72,416.
Total Cost of the Loan = Interest Amount + Processing Fees = ₹47,467 + ₹8,850 = ₹56,317.

We work with RBI-registered NBFCs. These NBFCs are as follows: 
-Si Creva Capital Services Pvt Ltd
-MAS Financial Services Ltd
-Northern Arc Capital Ltd.
-Piramal Capital & Housing Finance Ltd.
-SMFG India Credit Co. Ltd.   

Steps to apply for Personal Loan & Business Loan?
1. Install Kissht Personal loan app
2. Register with a mobile number
3. Complete 100% digital PAN & KYC process
4. Choose loan amount & tenure
5. Sign online loan agreements from approved NBFCs
6. Provide bank details
7. Request a money transfer to your bank account

Kissht Digital Lending App Features

✔ Instant online loan
✔ 100% Digital process
✔ Flexible EMI Repayment
✔ Low interest rate
✔ Fast loan approval

What Makes Kissht a Unique Digital Loan App?
1. Easy Loan Approval: Get instant loans online with minimal documentation in a fully 100% digital process.
2. Instant Loan Transfer: You can get funds directly disbursed to your bank account.
3. Short Term Loan Amount: 5k, 10k, 15k, 20k, 25k, 30k, 35k, 40k, 45k, 50k Personal Loan
4. Long Term Loan Amount: 1 Lakh, 2 Lakh, 3 Lakh, 4 Lakh, and 5 Lakh Personal Loan
5. Competitive Interest Rates: Enjoy a lower-interest loan with flexible EMI repayment.

Our Commitment to Customer Safety
1. Payment reminders are communicated via registered landline numbers only; we do not use personal or foreign mobile numbers.
2. Payments are collected exclusively through our app or website; we never request payments to personal accounts.
3. Our collection processes adhere to RBI and MeitY guidelines, with all calls monitored to prevent threats or abuse.
4. The Kissht app respects your privacy, does not access your Contacts List, and does not contact your friends or relatives about loan repayments.

Contact Us:
1. Write to care@kissht.com OR call our customer care number on 08044745884 / 08062816309. 
2. Share with us a screenshot or recording of the message or call.  Address: 10th Floor, Tower 4, Equinox Park, LBS Marg, Kurla (West), Mumbai - 400070

details.title: BharatPe for Business
details.description:
Introducing BharatPe for Business
BharatPe for Business is a comprehensive payment app allowing you to accept UPI and card payments from any app. A single QR code enables merchants to seamlessly accept payments from Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM, Amazon UPI, and over 150 other banking apps. BharatSwipe supports both debit and credit card payments. Over 7 million merchants rely on BharatPe for Business for their payment solutions. Invest your earnings to earn up to 12% annual interest and obtain loans to grow your business at competitive low interest rates.

Accept all Types of Payment
BharatPe for Business enables you to accept payments from all major UPI apps like BharatPe, Paytm, PhonePe, and Google Pay. Additionally, customers can pay through multiple modes like Bank Account, RuPay Credit card and Wallet etc.
You can also withdraw money instantly and transfer it directly to your bank account.
Business Loans Made Easy


Merchant Loans:
Expand your business with low-interest loans on BharatPe, featuring a hassle-free, 100% online application process that requires no paperwork, collateral, or guarantees. Repay your loan effortlessly through Easy Daily Installments (EDI) or Easy Monthly Installments (EMI).
 
Loan Repayment Terms:
Repay in Easy Daily Installments (EDI) or Easy Monthly Installments (EMI)


Loan Amount: Rs. 10,000 to Rs. 15,00,000
Loan Tenure: 4 months to 24 months


Flat Interest Rate (per month):
Ranges from 1% - 1.75%
Processing fees: up to 5% + applicable GST
Determination of interest rate and processing fees is based on lender partner's credit assessment and pricing policy, the same will be communicated on the BharatPe for Business App while taking a loan  
 
Example:
Loan Amount: Rs. 1,00,000
Tenure: 6 months
Flat Interest Rate: 1.5% per month
Repayment Amount: Rs. 1,09,000
Total Interest Payable: Rs. 100,000 x 1.5% X 6 months = Rs. 9,000
Processing Fees (incl. GST): Rs. 4,720
Disbursed Amount: Rs. 100,000 (Loan Amount) - Rs. 4,720 (Processing Fees) = Rs. 95,280
Total Amount Payable: Rs. 1,09,000 (EDI of 606)
Total Cost of the Loan: Interest Amount + Processing Fees = Rs. 9,000 + Rs. 4,720 = Rs. 13,720

details.title: Axis Mobile: Pay, Invest & UPI
details.description:
Open by Axis Bank is a safe, secure and user friendly mobile banking application with 250+ cutting edge features and services satisfying more than just your regular banking queries.

Online Digital Savings Account

Now open a savings account online at your convenience! The latest version of open by Axis Bank allows you to get your digital savings account up and running from anywhere, with services such as video based KYC that can be set up at your convenience. You will also be instantly issued a Virtual Debit Card linked to your Digital Savings Account!
What’s more, you can enjoy various offers on your Digital Savings Account with Grab Deals, Axis Bank’s shopping portal.

Banking Transactions Simplified

Banking needs are often subjective to individuals, some prefer to get a comprehensive update of all their financial activities while others simply wish to check their savings account balance; so why shouldn’t your app be the same? Get a customisable dashboard on open by Axis Bank with the explore tab that grants you a one-stop access to your account balances as well as regularly used features like mutual fund investments, dues and more!
Apart from an interactive dashboard you also set-up a 6 digit MPIN when using open by Axis Bank. This is a cross platform security code that can help you validate fund transfers from your savings account and transactions on your App, as well as log in to internet banking and authenticate Debit/Credit Card payments. The Bhim Unified Payment Interface (UPI) is also enabled on Axis Bank, letting you make UPI payments, Add Payees, Scan & Pay instantly as well as Make Your Own UPI QR Code. UPI ID is a unique ID that is used to make UPI payments in place of bank account details. UPI PIN is a 4- or 6-digit number which needs to be set by you while creating your UPI ID. Please don’t share your UPI PIN. Additionally, you can also find a record of transactions made for your ready reference via:

• UPI Transaction history
• Savings Account summary
• Card Statements
• Utility Bill Payments made to over 200 registered billers

Avail Services at One Touch

Whether it’s a Mutual Fund you seek to start or open FDs & RDs, open by Axis Bank lets you do that and more! Experience a newly re-vamped Mutual Fund journey along with instant opening of Digital Savings Accounts, access to Insurance services & Credit Card application.
Alternatively, if you’re seeking to avail funds instead of investing them, get instantly sanctioned pre-approved 24x7 loans! One can easily avail 100% digital Personal Loan as well in few simple steps.

Apart from new ones, you can also easily access and control existing services such as your Savings Account /Loan statements, Forex, Demat and Mutual Fund details, Credit and Debit Cards statements or converting your Credit Card dues into EMI.

GoodScore’s credit score is powered by CRIF High Mark, CIBIL and Experian: 3 of the 4 credit bureaus authorized by RBI.

The information on your credit report summarizes how you manage credit, including payment history, credit accounts, outstanding balances, defaults, credit utilization, credit mix and loan enquiries – important factors that impact credit score.

We analyze all your active and closed credit accounts for payment patterns and credit behaviour and offer personalized guidance to help you make the right decisions as you work towards achieving your desired credit score.

We also provide spend analyzer report that gives you daily update on your credits and debits. This in-turn will help you better manage your payments. We also allow you to setup UPI and make UPI payments through us.

GoodScore helps you understand the factors that affect your CIBIL, CRIF and Experian credit scores and gives you a personalized video recording on how to manage your credit.

Our credit score builder service includes the following:
✅Monthly tracking of your credit score and detailed report
✅Identifying areas which are affecting your credit score
✅Tips on how to manage your credit score
✅Monthly review of financial decisions and steps taken

📊Check your credit score:
You can check your CIBIL, Experian & CRIF High Mark Credit Score any time on the app. CIBIL, Experian & CRIF High Mark are among the 4 major Credit information companies in India.

When you have a good Credit score, you’ll become eligible to get loans & credit cards from India’s top banks like HDFC Bank, SBI, Bank of Baroda, PNB, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, IDFC First Bank, IndusInd Bank, Bandhan Bank, RBL Bank, Federal Bank, etc.

👉Are CRIF & Experian credit scores different from CIBIL?
CRIF, Experian & CIBIL are different platforms owned by different credit information companies. However, all 3 companies are approved by the Reserve Bank of India.

The parameters chosen by CIBIL TransUnion, Experian & CRIF High Mark are majorly similar. All 3 companies have a similar mechanism to calculate the credit score. They use repayment history, credit mix, new credit and outstanding debt to make the credit report. Having a good credit history in CIBIL will have somewhat similar results with CRIF High Mark and Experian as well.

Get updates regarding your bills, Cards, Loans, Bank Accounts and more.

✔ SmartLock: 

Control access to banking services such as Net Banking, UPI, and Credit and Debit Cards in one swipe.

NRI customers can conduct UPI payments with their international mobile number.

✔ Chatbot assistance:

details.description:
Product Features
Amazon Shopping offers app-only benefits to help make shopping on Amazon faster and easier than shopping on your desktop.

Never miss a delivery
Get real-time tracking and delivery notifications so you know where your package is and when it arrives. 

Know exactly what you’re purchasing
Full 360° product view lets you see items from every angle. “View in your room” makes sure it fits by using your phone’s camera and VR so you can see it in your space. 

We’ll notify you when items go on sale
Just tap the heart icon to save items to Your Lists and we’ll alert you of price drops so you don’t miss a deal. 

Never forget your password
Save time by staying securely signed in. If you prefer to sign out, use facial or fingerprint identification to sign back in. 

Connect with us when it works best for you
Live chat support is open 24 hours, 7 days a week. Once you’ve started a chat, it stays that way for 24 hours so you don’t have to start your support session from the beginning. 

We’ll find that item for you
Not sure of an item’s brand or where to buy it? Just tap the scan icon in the search bar, take a picture of the item or its barcode, and we’ll find it for you.

Product Description
Browse, search, view product details, read reviews, and purchase millions of products. We deliver to 100+ countries in as quickly as 3-5 days. Whether you’re buying gifts, reading reviews, tracking orders, scanning products, or just shopping, Amazon Shopping app offers more benefits than shopping on Amazon via your desktop.   

Important Note Regarding Permissions
Please note that the Amazon Shopping app requires access to the following services to operate properly:
* Contacts: Allows you to send Amazon gift cards to your contacts or invitation to install the Amazon app.
* Camera: Allows the Amazon app to access your camera on the device. You can use your camera to find products by scanning the cover or its barcode, to add gift cards and credit cards, or to add pictures in the product reviews.
* Flashlight: Allows the Amazon app to turn on the flashlight. You can use the flashlight to find products with the camera feature even in low-light or dark conditions.
* Microphone: Allows the Amazon app to access your microphone to use your voice to search and interact with your Assistant.
* Location: Allows the Amazon app to access your location to help you discover local offers and select addresses fast.
* Account: Allows you to share products on Amazon with your friends and families through Facebook or other social networks.
* Phone: Allows the Amazon app to pre-populate the Amazon Customer Service number on your phone’s keypad.
* Storage: Allows the Amazon app to store your preferences so that some features can load and run faster on the device.
* Wi-Fi: This permission is used when setting up either a Dash Button or Dash Wand using the Amazon Shopping app.

The Amazon App for Tablets is available on Google Play. Search for "Amazon Tablet" to install the app and begin shopping.

For customers located within the European Union, United Kingdom, Brazil, or Turkey: By using this app, you agree to Amazon’s Conditions of Use applicable for your country. details.description:
FlexPay – Instant Personal Loan App in India
FlexPay is a fast, secure, and user-friendly instant personal loan app designed
to provide quick access to credit for salaried and self-employed individuals
across India. With a fully digital and paperless loan application process,
FlexPay enables users to apply online and receive loans of up to ₹3,00,000 directly into their bank
account instantly.
FlexPay is an offering from Vivifi India Finance Pvt. Ltd. (N-09.00447), a
Non-Banking Financial Company registered with the Reserve Bank of India,
ensuring full regulatory compliance, transparency, and customer trust.
FlexPay aims to simplify borrowing by offering instant approval, and complete transparency
throughout the journey.
Whether you need funds for an emergency or an unexpected expense, FlexPay
ensures fast financial support anytime, anywhere.
FlexPay Loan Details & Charges
● Loan Amount: Up to ₹3,00,000
● Interest Rate: 18% – 42% per annum
● APR: 20% – 70%
● Tenure: Up to 36 months
● Processing Fee: Up to 5% + GST
● Late Fee: Up to ₹150 per instance
● Auto-Debit Failure Fee: Up to ₹60 per instance
● Prepayment Charges: ₹0
Example of a FlexPay Personal Loan
● Loan Amount Approved: ₹2,00,000
● Processing Fee: ₹11,800
● Interest Rate: 34%
● Tenure: 9 months
● EMI: ₹25,425.75

Why Choose FlexPay?
FlexPay offers instant credit with minimal documentation and fast
loan disbursal. There are no hidden charges, and all fees are clearly
communicated before loan confirmation. Users can conveniently manage their
loans through the app by tracking EMIs, checking outstanding dues, reviewing
repayment history, and monitoring loan status in real time.
The repayment structure allows borrowers to repay early without any
additional penalty, giving them complete control over their finances.
Eligibility Criteria
To apply for a FlexPay personal loan, applicants must meet the following
conditions:
● Indian citizen
● Minimum age of 21 years
● Minimum monthly income of ₹8,000
● Valid PAN card and active bank account
● Salaried or self-employed individual
Documents Required
● Identity Proof (PAN card / Voter ID / Passport etc.)
● Address Proof (Aadhaar card / Utility bill / Passport etc.)
● Income Proof (Salary slips / bank statements)
Usage of Loan Amount
FlexPay personal loans can be used for a wide range of purposes, including
medical emergencies, education expenses, utility bill payments, or any other
urgent financial requirement. The app is designed to support both short-term
and long-term financial needs with affordable and manageable EMIs that suit
different income profiles.
Safety & Data Security
FlexPay follows strict security and privacy standards to safeguard customers
information. The app uses advanced encryption technology to protect personal
and financial data. All information shared by users is securely stored and used
only for verification, credit assessment, and loan processing in accordance with
applicable regulations and data protection guidelines.
How to Apply for a FlexPay Loan
1. Download the FlexPay App
2. Register via mobile number and verify with the OTP
3. Fill in personal, employment and bank details
4. Complete the video KYC
5. Get all the details verified
6. Complete E-sign & E mandate
7. Get your loan disbursed
Customer Support & Contact Details
● Email: support@flexpay.in
● Phone: +91-40-4617-5151
● Address: Unit A, 9th Floor, MJR Magnifique, Khajaguda X Roads, Raidurgam,
Hyderabad, Telangana – 500008

details.description:
GS Finance is a digital loan app offered by GS Leasing and Finance Private Limited, an RBI-registered Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) (RBI Registration No.: B-03.00124).

The app provides personal loans with transparent charges, clear EMI schedules, secure digital KYC, and responsible lending practices.
All loans are offered strictly subject to eligibility, verification, and internal credit assessment, in accordance with RBI guidelines and Google Play loan policies.

📌 Loan Details

Loan Amount: ₹1,000 to ₹2,00,000

Repayment Tenure: 61 days to 365 days

✅ Processing Fee
A one-time loan processing fee of 1% to 5% of the loan amount (plus applicable taxes) may be charged at the time of loan disbursement. The exact processing fee is clearly shown to the user in the app before loan confirmation.

✅ Late Payment Fees

If an EMI is not paid on or before the due date, late payment fees may be applicable as per the loan agreement. Any such charges, along with applicable taxes, are transparently disclosed in the app. No hidden or compound charges are applied.

Loan Type: Personal Loan

Loan Disbursal : Directly by RBI-registered NBFC

✅ Key Features

100% online and paperless loan process

Transparent loan terms, charges, and EMI schedules

Secure digital KYC and identity verification

eNACH / auto-debit facility for EMI payments

In-app EMI schedule, repayment history, and loan status

Ticket-based customer support and grievance redressal system

👤 Loan Eligibility Criteria

Salaried and self-employed individuals can apply

Age: 21 to 55 years

Documents Required: Valid PAN and Aadhaar

Active bank account with income proof required

Loan approval depends on eligibility, credit score, and verification

📊 Representative Loan Example

Loan Amount: ₹10,000
Repayment Tenure: 3 Months (91 Days)
Interest Rate (APR): 18% to 36% per annum

Charges Breakdown
Processing Fee: ₹300

GST @18% on Processing Fee: ₹54

Total Processing Charges: ₹354

Disbursement Details

Loan Amount: ₹10,000

Less: Processing Charges (including GST): ₹354

➡ Net Disbursed Amount: ₹9,646

✅ Repayment Details

Total Interest (for 3 months): ₹404

Total Repayment Amount: ₹10,404
(Repayment through EMIs as per agreed schedule)

⏰ Loan Disbursement Timing

Timing: 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM

Days: Monday to Saturday (excluding bank holidays)

Loans approved outside business hours are disbursed on the next working day

🔐 Payment SDK Usage Disclosure

This app uses the PayU Payment Gateway SDK only for authorized EMI repayments related to active loans.

Used only when the user initiates an EMI payment

Not used for loan disbursement or background transactions

No card, UPI, or banking credentials are stored by the app or the SDK

All transactions are processed securely as per RBI guidelines and Google Play policies

🛡️ Payments & Security

EMI repayments are processed only through authorized payment gateways

User consent is required for every payment transaction

The app does not access or store sensitive payment credentials

🔎 KYC & Data Privacy

KYC is conducted using secure and authorized verification partners

Personal data is collected only for loan processing, servicing, and regulatory compliance

The app does not access contacts, photos, media files, call logs, or device storage

🎧 Customer Support & Grievance Redressal

Contact Details

Email: support@gsfinance.in

Phone: 9244565757

Website: https://gsfinance.in

details.title: BikeWale- Bikes & Two Wheelers
details.description:
Are you in the quest to look out for a new bike or scooter? Finding a two wheeler that would be the best for you is definitely not an easy task. There are a plethora of options out in the market, which can make it really difficult for you to select the one that would be the right fit for you. Don’t worry! The BikeWale app is here to help you out. The app brings at your fingertips the important features of a two wheeler that you can consider to filter out and finally select the one you are looking for in the desired price bracket in your mind. 

The app also helps you to be in track with the exhaustive coverage of the current on-road prices of the bikes, you can compare bikes of your choice. Along with it, the app also keeps you updated about the latest developments in the two wheeler industry in India, it houses two wheelers’ reviews and videos by the experts, and also has a dedicated section for the user reviews. Additionally, the app also helps you to get in touch with the dealers in your region and know your bike loan eligibility.

To highlight the important features of the app-

1. Search- Browse through the bikes of your choice. The app hosts the two wheelers from the best manufacturers. To name some - Royal Enfield, TVS, Hero, Bajaj, Honda, Yamaha, Suzuki, KTM, Jawa, BMW, Harley-Davidson, Yezdi, Ather, Ducati, Bounce, Okinawa, Moto Morini among many others.

2. Specifications list- Get almost everything you require to know about a bike, properly organized in a single place. This can help to zero down to the bike you are looking for by providing you the detailed information regarding displacement, mileage, transmission, max power, fuel type capacity, etc. 

3. Price Quotes- Get the ex-showroom price quotes for all the bikes sold in India. The app also helps you to check the on-road price for many cities in India like Mumbai, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Kolkata, Chennai among many others

4. Compare Bikes- The app helps you to get a detailed comparison of the bikes you are looking for in regards to the important features and prices exhaustively to make an informed decision. 

5. EMI Calculator- Calculate your bike loan EMI on the basis of the loan amount, tenure, down payment and interest rate

6. News - Be updated with the latest changes in the two wheeler industry, day to day. Avail the news around launches, discounts, top sellers and many more.

7. Expert & User Reviews - View the reviews by experts (both expert review articles and video reviews) explaining the nitty gritty of the bike or scooter, in order to help you to make an informed decision. You can also avail the reviews written by the actual users which can also help you in your decision making.

8. Contact Dealers- A one click solution for you to get in touch with the dealers for your selected brand and the city. 

9. Bike Loan- Know your eligibility for a bike loan from the leading financial institutions at the best interest Rates, EMI options and repayment tenure for the two wheeler you wish to purchase. 

In all, the BikeWale app is a holistic solution to make your life a lot easier when it comes to a bike or any two wheeler purchase. Download the app now to experience the new way of researching on two wheelers.

Empowering 40 lakh+ users, Viva Money is a trusted loan app that makes accessing funds simple, fast, and flexible.

Whether it's an unexpected expense, a planned purchase, or a temporary cash crunch, users can access funds in just a few taps. It gives you the flexibility to access funds when you need them most.

Viva Money is a trusted 0% interest loan app that offers a seamless digital borrowing experience. As a reliable loan app to get cash instantly, it provides safe and transparent access to funds through its partnership with FincFriends Private Limited, an RBI-registered NBFC.

Why Choose Viva Money Loan App?
With the Viva Money app, you get:

📌 100% digital, hassle-free process

📌 Approvals in less than 15 minutes

Who Can Apply for Viva Money Loan App to Get Cash Instantly?
You can easily apply for a loan through Viva Money if you fulfill the following criteria:
✅ Minimum monthly income of ₹15,000 or household income of ₹25,000
✅ Must be in the age group of 21 to 64 years
✅ Must be a resident of Karnataka, Maharashtra, Gujarat, Tamil Nadu, Haryana, Delhi or Goa.

Documents Required:
✅ PAN Card
✅ Aadhaar Card

How Does Viva’s 0% Interest Loan App Work?
Example: Hrithik was searching for a quick money app on 1st January and discovered Viva Money. He applied for ₹1,50,000 and got instant loan approval in 15 mins. 
On 1st February, he withdrew ₹50,000 to purchase a laptop. Since Viva Money offers a 51-day interest-free period, he can repay the amount by 20th March & enjoy a 0% interest loan.

A processing fee of 4.5%, along with a grace repayment fee of 1.5%, applies to the total withdrawal amount when the amount is repaid within the grace period. 
For repayments beyond this period, Hrithik can easily convert the balance into Flexible EMI options, based on his eligibility, through the rupee loan, with interest rates ranging from 18% to 40% APR on Viva Money.

For instance:
Withdrawn amount: ₹50,000
Tenure: 5 months
Interest rate: 40% per annum
Processing fee: 4.5% = ₹2,250 + GST = ₹2,655
Total interest for 5 months: ₹5,495
Total cost if paid in EMI = ₹50,000 + ₹2,655 + ₹6,810 = ₹58,150

Secure Lending with an RBI-registered NBFC:
Viva Money is an ISO-certified (27001:2022) loan app committed to keeping your data secure with advanced encryption technology. In partnership with RBI-registered NBFC FincFriends, we ensure a transparent and reliable borrowing experience with quick access to funds.

App Permissions Required:
📌 One-time access for camera, microphone, & location for VKYC

Data Security:
Every transaction on the Viva Money personal loan app is protected by advanced security measures.

Why is Viva Money among the best personal loan app in India?
Unlike other loan apps, the Viva Money instant personal loan app offers a faster, paperless process with flexible repayment options. Whether you're looking for a 10000 loan app, 20000 loan app, a salary loan, or a personal loan in Bangalore, Chennai, Delhi, or any other cities, or any other type of loan, Viva Money is your one-stop solution to get cash instantly.

We ensure quick, hassle-free access to funds to help you meet your financial needs. Ideal for working professionals, self-employed individuals, and small business owners.

Download Viva Money - your trusted loan app to get cash instantly!

Contact Us:

🌐 Website: https://vivamoney.in

details.title: Yuva - Personal Loan App
details.description:
Yuva is an instant personal loan app provided by YUVARAJ FINANCE PRIVATE LIMITED, a Non-banking Financial Company (NBFC) registered with the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) with the Certificate of Registration number B.-09.00301. 

1. DETAILS AND REPRESENTATIVE COST CALCULATION:

Details:
o Loan amount: up to 50,000 Rs.
o Tenure: 62 - 365 days
o Interest rate: 36% per annum 
The Annual Percentage Rate (APR) represents the total cost of borrowing on an annualized basis and includes the applicable interest rate along with other fees and permitted charges, calculated in accordance with applicable laws and regulatory guidelines. 

The Annual Percentage Rate (APR) applicable to our loans varies and depends on a variety of factors including loan tenure, and amount. Pricing is determined through a combination of algorithmic models and policy-based evaluation in line with applicable regulatory requirements. Our Annual Percentage Rate (including interest rate and all fees) can range from 45% to 195% per annum. APRs are by definition higher for shorter loan tenures and can also vary due to higher risk categorization based on the nature and structure of the loan product chosen. 

All costs associated with borrowing — including interest and any applicable fees — are presented clearly to customers in the Key Fact Statement (KFS) before they accept a loan. This ensures full transparency and allows borrowers to make well informed decisions and hence strictly follows the regulations of the RBI.

Representative Cost Calculation:

For example, if the loan amount is 5,000 Rs. with a repayment period of 124 days (four installments in 31 days each), the interest is 36% per annum with a one-time processing fee of 678 Rs. The total cost of the loan will be 382 Rs. (interest, calculated based on declining principal balance) + 678 Rs. (all fees applicable) = 1,060 Rs. The total amount to be paid is 5,000 Rs. + 1,060 Rs. = 6,060 Rs., so average monthly payment is 6,060 Rs. / 4 = 1,515. Rs and APR 97%.

2. BASIC ELIGIBILITY RULES FOR PERSONAL LOAN:
o Applicant must be an Indian adult citizen
o Possess a Valid PAN
o Aadhaar verification completed through Digilocker
o Monthly household income above 25,000 Rs. and the annual income over 3,00,000 Rs.
o Active and valid bank account 

3. DATA PROTECTION:
o We adhere to the regulatory requirements and industry standards being the member of FACE (Fintech Association for Consumer Empowerment)
o Your data is encrypted, securely stored, and can be requested to delete 
o We do not share your data with third parties without your consent
o Yuva App does not ask for sensitive permissions
o For more information, please visit the Data safety section

4. KEY FEATURES OF YUVA INSTANT LOAN APP:
o Competitive loan products
o Simple, intuitive user interface with a modern design
o Optimized application process with minimum steps and information required
o Various loan repayment options (UPI, card, wallet)
o 24/7 customer support via email, helpline, or WhatsApp chat

5. BENEFITS OF USING YUVA LOAN APP:
o Transparent pricing with no hidden or upfront fees
o Only essential documentation needed for approval
o Fast and hassle-free loan decision
o New-to-credit customers can be also considered
o Higher loan amounts available for repeat clients
o Secure platform with end-to-end encryption

6. HOW IT WORKS:
o Register with your phone number
o Choose your preferred loan amount and term
o Provide data for loan application and complete the KYC verification 
o Sign loan agreement 
o In case of loan approval the funds are  instantly transferred to your bank account, and the loan agreement becomes binding on the parties 

7. ANY QUESTIONS:
Please check the App support section to contact our team anytime.

details.description:
ET Money: All Your Wealth. One Intelligent App

ET Money helps you plan, invest, grow & manage your wealth, simply & intelligently.
Millions of Indians use it to build long-term wealth across various investment products, including Mutual Funds, SIF, Fixed Deposits, NPS, Bonds, Smallcases, PMS, AIFs & more.
It brings your plans, investments & insights together in one clean, powerful app.

All wealth products in one place

- Mutual Funds: Invest in the top mutual funds in India instantly. Start SIP or do a lumpsum effortlessly. No paperwork required. No demat account needed.
- SIFs: Specialized Investment Funds use advanced strategies to adapt to changing markets & protect your capital.
- Fixed Deposits: Get high-interest FDs from trusted names like Bajaj Finance, Shiram Finance & Survoday SF Bank. Insured up to ₹5 lakh by DICGC.
- Bonds: Earn up to 11% fixed returns with SEBI-regulated, top-rated bonds. No lock-in. Sell anytime.
- NPS: Build retirement savings with the world’s lowest-cost pension plan. Save up to ₹62,400 in taxes every year.
- Smallcases: Invest in curated stock portfolios designed around themes & strategies for long-term growth.
- PMS & AIFs: Access PMS & AIFs from India’s top fund managers.
- Loans Against Mutual Funds: Get instant liquidity without selling your investments. Borrow in minutes, pay interest monthly & repay the principal at any time.
- ET Money Cash: Get pre-approved personal loans instantly. No paperwork or collateral.
- Insurance: Secure your life & health with curated, reliable plans that fit your wealth goals.

Intelligent tools for smarter decisions

Investor Personality:
Understand your investing style & risk comfort through India’s most scientific assessment, built with behavioural experts. Align your decisions with who you truly are & stay confident through every market phase.

Fund Report Card:
Discover top funds with strong returns and downside protection, ranked by ET Money for true performance.

Fund Verdict:
Know instantly if a fund & the category are a good fit for you. Decided based on the risk taken by the fund & if it matches your risk tolerance. Also, get to know your ideal investment horizon & the best way to invest in it.

ET Money Select:
Get a personalised list of top mutual funds. Hand-picked after analysing millions of data points & mapped to your risk profile. Regularly reviewed to keep only the best aligned to you.

Portfolio Health Check:
Discover the true health of your portfolio. Get a score based on 100+ parameters — returns, risk, diversification & investing behaviour. See what’s working, what’s not & where to act.

Portfolio Breakdown:
See exactly where your money is invested across asset classes, sectors, companies, credit ratings & debt durations. Check if your diversification matches your plan.

Portfolio Fix:
Turn insights into action. Identify underperforming funds & get better, personalised replacements, so your portfolio always stays in top shape.

Mutual Fund Strategies: Built to Keep You Ahead

Expert-built, data-backed strategies personalised to your risk, goals & horizon. Diversified across assets & styles, rebalanced periodically & tracked with alerts, so you stay disciplined, confident & on course through every market phase.

Ease, Convenience & Control

- Track all your external mutual fund investments for free and view current & lifetime XIRR instantly.
- Download ready-to-use capital gains statements for taxes, free & accurate.
- Complete KYC instantly within the app. 100% paperless.
- Invest without a demat account. Everything from discovery to tracking happens securely on ET Money.

Why investors trust ET Money

- Trusted by 1cr+ investors across India.
- Part of the 360 ONE Wealth group, one of India’s largest wealth & asset managers.
- Regulated by SEBI, RBI, PFRDA, and IRDAI.

details.title: smallcase - Save & Invest
details.description:
smallcase is a great place to put your money to work. We have investment ideas across Indian Stocks & ETFs, Mutual Funds, Fixed Deposits, and for global diversification - US Stocks & ETFs.

What makes smallcase stand out from other investment apps is our 'model portfolios', also known as 'smallcases'. These are baskets of Indian Stocks/ETFs, Mutual Funds or US Stocks/ETFs. These smallcases are created by investment experts, around an idea like a trending sector (Defence, Pharma, etc.), a theme (AI & Data Centers, Clean Energy, etc.) or a trusted strategy (Momentum, Value & Growth, etc.)

To keep your investments fresh, these smallcases are periodically rebalanced by buy/sell recommendations of underlying stocks to keep up with market trends.

INVEST IN INDIAN STOCKS & ETFs
- Connect your existing broking or demat account, or open a new one. smallcase supports India's top brokers including Kite by Zerodha, Groww, Upstox, ICICI Direct, HDFC Securities, IIFL Securities, Angel One, Motilal Oswal, Axis Direct, Kotak Securities, 5paisa, Alice Blue, Nuvama, and more
- Select an idea to invest in like Electric Mobility, and leave the underlying stock picking to experts. They will research across EV manufacturers, charging service providers, battery manufacturers, etc. to find the most suitable for the smallcase
- SIP into multiple stocks in one go
- Apply rebalance updates periodically to keep your investments fresh

INVEST IN US STOCKS & ETFs
- Open a free Global Investing Account and fund it via your Indian bank account
- Invest in trending ideas unique to US markets like AI Supply Chain, Robotics, Country Rotation, etc. Leave the underlying stock picking to experts.
- Since fractional shares are supported, start investing with just $50
- Your investments stay fresh with automated rebalancing when the smallcase manager triggers a buy/sell action of underlying stocks
- Invest with confidence via the GIFT City framework, fully compliant with Indian regulations

INVEST IN MUTUAL FUNDS
- Invest in baskets of direct mutual funds with zero commission
- Select an idea like Parking your Savings, Sector Rotation, Flexicap Picks, etc, and leave the selection of underlying mutual funds to experts
- SIP into multiple mutual funds at once

TRACK YOUR NET WORTH WITH WEALTH OFFICE
- Get a 360° view of your finances across stocks, mutual funds, gold, real estate, FDs, EPF, loans, and credit health
- Chat with Wealth Office AI to uncover insights about your wealth, forecast your net worth, and get roadmaps for your financial goals

GET LOAN AGAINST SECURITIES
- Get a loan against your stock and mutual fund investments, without selling them
- Avail low interest rates starting at 9.9% p.a.
- Repay at any time with no foreclosure charges

Tenure: 36 months
Maximum Annual Percentage Rate (APR): 13%

Registered Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) Lenders:
- DSP Finance Private Limited
- The South Indian Bank Limited
- Bajaj Finance Limited

Interest Rate: 16% p.a.

Processing Fee: ₹2,073
GST: ₹373
Loan Insurance: ₹1,199

INVEST IN FIXED DEPOSITS
- Open high-interest FDs with returns up to 8.5% p.a.

- Choose from Slice SF, Shivalik SF Bank, and more

NOTE: Equity investments are subject to share market risk. Investments in global markets are subject to market, currency, regulatory, and jurisdictional risks. Read all the related documents carefully before investing. Investors should consider all risk factors and consult their financial advisors before investing. Kiwi is at the forefront of the digital payment revolution in India, offering an innovative UPI payment app that merges the convenience of UPI with the benefits of a rewards-based credit card. As a leading UPI app in India, this unique online payment app provides users with the ability to get exciting cashback on every transaction made via the UPI RuPay network. From everyday shopping and utility payments to credit card bill payments, Kiwi simplifies every transaction with a seamless and secure experience. 
Why does Kiwi stand out?

✅ Lifetime Free RuPay Credit Card: Get a lifetime free RuPay credit card with real  cashback & exclusive rewards on every transaction.
✅ Seamless UPI Payments: Use your RuPay Credit Card anywhere and everywhere with the ease of UPI - an effortless UPI credit card experience in India.

● Security: Kiwi prioritises the security of your financial information. The app utilises state-of-the-art encryption and security measures to protect your data, giving you complete peace of mind.

🌟 Discover the Kiwi Difference! 🌟
Kiwi transcends the ordinary UPI payment app. Among UPI apps in India, it offers a comprehensive financial ecosystem with a lifetime free RuPay credit card and significant cashback & rewards. Enjoy up to 50 days interest-free period on credit card payments with Kiwi as your trusted financial partner.

Who can apply for a loan?
Businesses operating as retailers, merchants, and distributors across India who are in business with commercial or digital platforms offering non-lending financial or merchant services can apply for MSME loans with GROx through their respective business engagement platforms. Eligibility depends on meeting GROx's lending terms and conditions and the digital platform being partnered with GROx.

How to apply for a loan on the GROx App?

Registered MSMEs in India with the required documentation and compliance with GROx's  eligibility criteria can apply.


UGRO Capital
https://www.ugrocapital.com/lending-service-provider#digital-Lending-apps

Important Information on MSME Loans
Our Loan Products
1. Credit Lines
Short-term loans designed for daily working capital needs, with daily auto-debit repayments synced with your business inflows.

2. Short-Term Working Capital Loans (EDI/EWI)
90-day credit products with Equated Daily/Weekly Installments. Ideal for managing inventory restocking and short business cycles.

3.Working Capital Term Loans
Tenures of 3, 6, 9, or 12 months with structured repayment schedules. Perfect for slightly longer-term growth or seasonal expansion.

Repayment Period: 3 months (min.) to 36 months (max.)
Max. Annual Percentage Rate (APR): 48%

Representative Example of the total cost of the loan
This is an example to help our customers understand how EMI, interest and other costs are calculated. Actual amount, tenure, interest rate & processing fee will depend on the customer's risk profile.
Loan Amount = ₹1,00,000
Duration = 12 months
Interest rate = 26%
Monthly EMI = ₹9,553
EMI = [P x R x (1+R)^N]/[(1+R)^N-1], P Loan Amount, R interest rate & N duration.
Total Interest [(EMI x 12) – Loan Amount]: (₹9553 x 12) - (₹1,00,000) = ₹14,636
Other costs include Processing Fee (@2% + 18% GST): ₹1,00,000 x 2% = ₹2,000 + 18% GST = ₹2,360.
Total costs = ₹14,636 + ₹2,360 = ₹16,996
Total Repayment = ₹1,00,000 + ₹16,996 = ₹1,16,996
*Final loan amount, tenure, interest rate, and processing fee are customized based on your business profile, transaction data, and platform partner integration.

details.description:
Paisa247 helps users discover and compare personal loan offers from verified and trusted lenders across India. We provide a digital loan comparison platform that enables users to check preliminary eligibility and apply online securely with RBI-registered lending partners.

Lending Partners
Paisa247 is a loan comparison platform that connects borrowers with the following RBI-registered NBFCs and banks:
• Chinmay Finlease Limited
• Baba Lease and Investment Private Limited
• Meghdoot Mercantile Private Limited

Loan Terms
• Repayment Period: Minimum 3 months to Maximum 60 months
• Maximum APR: Up to 36% per annum (inclusive of interest, processing fees, and other applicable charges)
• Actual interest rates, fees, and loan terms vary by lender and borrower eligibility

Representative Example
For a personal loan of ₹1,00,000 at an annual interest rate of 24% for a tenure of 24 months:
• Monthly EMI: ₹5,287
• Processing Fee: ₹2,000 (2%)
• Total Interest Payable: ₹26,888
• Total Amount Payable: ₹1,28,888

Actual loan offers, interest rates, EMIs, and fees may vary based on lender policies and borrower credit assessment.

What Paisa247 Does
• Access and compare multiple personal loan offers from RBI-registered lenders
• Preliminary personal loan eligibility check
• View complete transparency on interest rates, EMIs, processing fees, and tenure
• Fully digital, secure, and paperless application process
• Track balance, credit line, and repayment schedules from a single dashboard
• Available for salaried and self-employed individuals
• EMI calculator to help plan repayments effectively

Important Disclosures
• Paisa247 is not a lender and does not issue loans directly.
• Loan approval is not guaranteed and is subject to eligibility checks, credit assessment, and approval by the respective RBI-registered lending partners.
• Interest rates, processing fees, repayment tenure, and loan amounts are determined solely by the lending partner.
• Processing fees, if applicable, vary by lender and borrower profile and are disclosed before loan acceptance.
• Paisa247 does not provide financial advisory services, credit repair, or credit score improvement services.

Regulatory Compliance
All lending partners available on Paisa247 are RBI-registered NBFCs or banks and comply with RBI Digital Lending Guidelines. Paisa247 acts solely as a technology and loan comparison platform and does not participate in lending or credit decision-making.

Data Security & Privacy
Your data is handled securely and in accordance with our Privacy Policy: https://paisa247.in/privacy-policy

Customer Support: support@paisa247.in

Why Choose PocketRupee?
1. Convenient and Efficient:A fully digital application process that saves time and effort.
2. Safe and Secure:User data is protected with secure encryption and handled in accordance with applicable data protection standards.
3. User-Friendly Experience:A simple and easy-to-use interface designed for a smooth borrowing experience.
 
PocketRupee User Guide
To ensure compliance and fund security, applicants must meet the following basic requirements:
1. Must be an Indian resident aged 18 years or above
2. Must have a valid mobile number and bank account
3. Must provide valid KYC documents (such as PAN, Aadhaar, etc.)
4. Must meet internal credit assessment criteria
 
Loan Products
Loan Amount: INR 3,000 – INR 120,000

Processing Fee: Based on the loan amount and tenure
Goods and Services Tax (GST): 18% GST is applicable on the processing fee as per Indian laws and policies.
 
Calculation Example
Loan Amount: INR 10,000Loan Tenure: 120 daysAnnual Interest Rate: 18%
Total Interest Payable:10,000 × 18% × 120 ÷ 365 = INR 592
Processing Fee (1%):10,000 × 1% = INR 100
GST on Processing Fee:100 × 18% = INR 18
Disbursed amount:10,000 - 100 - 18 = INR 9,882
Total Repayment Amount:10,000 + 592 = INR 10,592
Estimated Monthly Payment(average) = INR 2,648APR: (592 + 100 + 18) ÷ 9,882 ÷ 120 × 365 ≈ 21.9%
 
Note: The above example is for illustrative purposes only. Actual loan terms, interest rates, fees, and repayment amounts may vary based on user eligibility, credit assessment, and platform policies.

UdhaarSaathi (Formerly InstaVyapaar): Daily Working Capital for Kirana & Small Shop Owners

UdhaarSaathi is a merchant finance app designed to support kirana shop owners, small businesses and merchants who need funds & working capital loans and business loans for daily business operations. Whether you need money to buy stock in the morning, pay suppliers, or manage daily expenses, our business loan app and merchant funding app helps keep your shop running smoothly.

Agar aapko roz ke business ke liye paise ki zarurat padti hai, UdhaarSaathi aapke liye ek simple aur practical solution hai.

This small merchant funding is designed to support your daily business needs and can be repaid after completing your day’s sales. Whether you run a salon, grocery shop, pharmacy, fashion retail store, or another small business, our online merchant lending app helps manage your short-term financial needs through a simple and easy process.

Simple idea hai: Small working capital loan lo, din bhar business karo, aur din khatam hone par repayment karo.

Why Choose UdhaarSaathi for Your Business?

UdhaarSaathi is built to match how small businesses operate every day, offering flexible merchant loans and working capital funding that support regular shop activities. The platform provides short-term merchant funding options that help maintain steady business operations without long waiting periods.

Key Benefits for Small Businesses:

✅ Working Capital Loans from ₹25,000 to ₹250000 for Small Merchants 
✅ Fast approvals
✅ Daily EDI loan repayment facility
✅ Simple and transparent process
✅ Designed specifically for small businesses

Daily Working Capital Loan Supporting Merchants with Everyday Business Needs

Every kirana store, hardware shop, electronics store, or medical shop requires daily cash to manage business operations. Sometimes stock runs out, suppliers request advance payments, or customer demand suddenly increases, making extra funds necessary.

Aise time par UdhaarSaathi chhote merchants ko quick working capital deta hai taaki unka business kabhi ruk na jaye.

Simple Eligibility for Small Shop Owners

Eligibility for UdhaarSaathi merchant loans is based on your business activity and regular operations. If your shop runs consistently and accepts digital payments, you may qualify for small working capital loans through a straightforward application process.

You may be eligible if:

→ You run an active small business
→ Your shop accepts QR or UPI payments
→ Your daily sales are regular
→ Your business is operational

Earn First, Then Repay:

Traditional loans usually require fixed monthly EMIs, which may not match the daily earning pattern of a small business. UdhaarSaathi (Formerly InstaVyapaar) offers a repayment system that allows merchants to repay after completing their daily sales cycle, making it easier to manage cash flow.

The process is simple:

✅ Take a working capital loan for your business needs
✅ Run your shop and generate sales
✅ Repay at the end of the day

Isse aapka business smoothly chalta rehta hai bina extra financial pressure ke.

Example Loan Calculation:

→ Total Cost of the Loan = Interest Amount + Processing Fees = ₹ 84,600 + ₹ 13,275 = ₹ 97,875.

Loan Amount: ₹ 20,000
Tenure: 3 Months

Collect, store & monitor information about the location of your device to do a risk assessment for credit scoring.

details.title: SuryaLoan: Personal Loan App
details.description:
The SuryaLoan mobile application by Raghavi Finance Ltd offers a seamless way to access instant loans. Whether you need a small amount or a larger sum, SuryaLoan provides flexible loan options to meet your financial needs with a tenure of up to 365 days. Our competitive interest rates and clear Annual Percentage Rate (APR) calculation ensure transparency in the cost of borrowing.
How It Works:
1.⁠ ⁠Download the App:
    * Available on the App Store and Google Play Store.
    * Free to download and use.
2.⁠ ⁠Register:
    * Sign up with your phone number.
    * Complete your profile with basic personal and financial information.
3.⁠ ⁠Apply for a Loan:
    * Select the loan amount from ₹5,000 to ₹1,00,000 and a repayment term of up to 365 days.
    * Upload the necessary documents and submit your application.
4.⁠ ⁠Get Approved:
    * Receive instant approval and loan offer.
    * Review and accept the loan terms.
5.⁠ ⁠Receive Funds:
    * Loan amount is credited to your bank account within minutes.
6.⁠ ⁠Repay on Time:
    * Follow the repayment schedule provided in the app.
    * Make payments directly through the app using our secure payment gateway.
Repayment Schedule:
•⁠  ⁠Flexible Tenure: Choose a repayment period of up to 365 days that fits your financial situation.
•⁠  ⁠Automated Reminders: Receive notifications before each due date to ensure timely payments.
•⁠  ⁠Transparency: Detailed view of the principal, interest, and remaining balance.
APR Calculation Detailed Example:

details.title: Chinmay - Personal Loan App
details.description:
Online Loan App for Instant Personal Loan & Loan Against Mutual Funds

Chinmay Finlease Limited is a trusted digital loan app offering both Instant Personal Loans and Loan Against Mutual Funds (LAMF) to meet individuals' financial needs through a 100% digital and paperless loan process. Whether you need a quick online loan for emergencies or wish to unlock the value of your mutual fund investments without redeeming them, our online loan app provides a hassle-free way to borrow digitally.

Chinmay Finlease Limited is an RBI-approved NBFC, registered under registration No. B.01.00558 and have been serving every individual across India since 11 December 1996. With over 25 years of lending experience, we adhere to strict data protection and regulatory norms, ensuring your personal and financial information is always safe & secure.

Instant Personal Loan Online

Loan Details
• Loan Amount: ₹10,000 - ₹5,00,000
• TAT: 15 minutes
• Repayment Tenure: 3 to 18 months
• Interest Rates: starts from 28% p.a.

Eligibility Criteria
• Indian Resident
• Salaried professionals aged 21 to 55 years
• Earning a minimum monthly salary of ₹25,000
• Having a Credit Score of 600 and above

Documents Required
• Aadhaar Card
• PAN Card
• Last 3 months’ salary slips or bank statement

APR Disclosure & Associated Charges
- Interest Rate: starts from 28% p.a.
- Annual Percentage Rate (APR): 26% to 36%
- Processing Charge: 5% of loan amount
- Documentation Charge: 1.5% of loan amount
- Online Convenience Charge: ₹200
- Bounce Charge: ₹500 per occurrence

Notes: GST and other applicable charges may be levied in addition to the above charge structure.

Illustrative Calculation
Loan Amount= ₹30,000
Interest Rate= 28% p.a.
Loan Duration= 180 Days

Total interest on the personal loan= ₹4,142
Processing charge (5% of the loan amount) + Documentation charge (1.5% of the loan amount) + Online Convenience charge (₹200) = ₹2,150*
18% GST = ₹387
Total Deductions (Processing charge + Documentation charge + Online Convenience charge + GST)= ₹2,537

Net Disbursed Amount= Loan Amount - Total Deductions= ₹27,463
Total Repayable Amount (Loan Amount + Interest)= ₹34,142

*Processing charge, Documentation charge, and Online Convenience charge are deducted upfront at the time of loan disbursal.


Loan Against Mutual Funds

Loan Details
• Loan Amount: ₹10,000 - ₹3,00,000
• Repayment Tenure: 365 days
• Interest Rate: 18% p.a.

Eligibility Criteria
• Indian Resident
• Age between 18 to 60 years
• Holder of eligible mutual fund investments of 20,000/-

Documents Required
• Aadhaar Card
• PAN Card
• Registered mobile number & email address linked to your investments

APR Disclosure & Associated Charges
- Interest Rate: 18% p.a.
- Bounce Charges: ₹500 per occurrence
- Processing Charge: 3.50% of loan amount
- Documentation Charge: 1% of loan amount
- Online Convenience Charge: ₹200
- Pledge & Unpledge Charge: As per RTA

Notes: GST will be added to the above charges as applicable.

Illustrative Calculation
Loan Amount= ₹50,000
Interest Rate= 18% p.a.
Loan Duration= 180 Days

Total interest on the LAMF= ₹4,438
Processing charge (3.50%) + Documentation charge (1%) + Online Convenience charge (₹200) + Pledge & Unpledge charge (₹600) = ₹3,050
18% GST = ₹549

Total Deductions (Processing charges + Documentation charges + Online convenience charge + Pledge & Unpledge charge + GST)= ₹3,599

Net Disbursed Amount= Loan Amount - Total Deductions= ₹46,401
Total Repayable Amount (Loan Amount + Interest)= ₹54,438

Disclaimer: Final terms are subject to your credit profile and risk assessment.

details.title: BrightLoans
details.description:
BrightLoans is a Digital Lending Application (DLA) developed and operated by VIMANOTECH INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED. We act as a Loan Service Provider (LSP) that enables eligible users to discover, compare, and apply for personal loan offers from RBI-registered Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs).
About BrightLoans

BrightLoans provides a secure digital platform where users can explore eligible loan offers, select a preferred lending partner, complete the loan application process, and track their application digitally.

Once a lending partner is selected, the complete loan journey—including eligibility assessment, document verification, Account Aggregator (AA) consent (where applicable), loan agreement execution, loan disbursement, and repayment services—is facilitated on behalf of the selected RBI-registered NBFC using its authorized systems and APIs.

Important Disclosure

BrightLoans is not a lender, NBFC, or financial institution.
We do not directly lend money or independently approve loan applications. Loan eligibility, approval, sanctioned amount, interest rates, processing fees, repayment schedules, and all other loan terms are determined solely by the selected RBI-registered NBFC.
Submitting a loan application through BrightLoans does not guarantee loan approval.
BrightLoans does not facilitate loans with repayment tenures of 60 days or less, in accordance with Google Play Personal Loans Policy and applicable RBI Digital Lending Guidelines.

Personal Loan Features

Eligible users may apply for personal loans for various financial needs, including:
• Medical expenses
• Education expenses
• Travel expenses
• Emergency financial needs
• Other eligible personal purposes

Representative Loan Terms (Offered by RBI-Registered NBFC Partners)

• Loan Amount: ₹5,000 – ₹1,50,000
• Repayment Tenure: 61 – 365 days
• Annual Percentage Rate (APR): Up to 35% per annum
• Processing Fee: Up to 2% of the loan amount + applicable GST
• Prepayment Charges: Nil
• Late Payment Charges: As specified by the respective lending partner.

Representative Loan Example

• Loan Amount: ₹50,000
• Loan Tenure: 365 days
• APR: 35% per annum
• Processing Fee: ₹1,000 + GST (₹180)
• Net Amount Disbursed: ₹48,820
• Monthly EMI: ₹4,998
• Total Repayment Amount: ₹59,978
• Total Interest Payable: ₹9,978
The above example is provided for illustration purposes only. Actual loan eligibility, sanctioned amount, interest rate, processing fee, repayment schedule, and other applicable charges are determined solely by the selected RBI-registered NBFC.

https://brightloans.in/digital-lending-partners

Compliance & Transparency
• Operated by VIMANOTECH INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
• Functions as a Loan Service Provider (LSP)
• Loans are offered, approved, and disbursed exclusively by RBI-registered NBFC lending partners.
• BrightLoans facilitates the complete digital loan journey on behalf of the selected lending partner using its authorized systems and APIs.
• Where authorized by the lending partner, loan repayments may be facilitated through the BrightLoans application using the lender's approved payment systems and APIs.
